_meta.title: Redlining: HOLC neighbourhood grades, 1935-1940
_meta.what: Every neighbourhood graded by the US Home Owners' Loan Corporation (HOLC). Grade A 'Best' (green) to D 'Hazardous' (red); D areas were 'redlined', mostly because Black, immigrant or Jewish residents lived there.
_meta.source: Mapping Inequality: Redlining in New Deal America, Digital Scholarship Lab, University of Richmond
_meta.licence: CC BY-NC 2.5 (spatial data); the original maps and area descriptions are public domain
_meta.citation: Nelson, R. K., Winling, L, et al. (2023). Mapping Inequality: Redlining in New Deal America. Digital Scholarship Lab. https://dsl.richmond.edu/panorama/redlining
_meta.processing: Polygons simplified with mapshaper (12% of vertices kept, keep-shapes, 4-decimal coordinates). Every polygon and every source field kept except 'fill' (the site's display colour, which follows grade). Grade values are as published, including blanks and the rare E/F grades.
